benchmark_context.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

suite.baseline_scope: Fixed int, Item and nested Box workloads on syntax-valid JSON. Both validate all structure before constructors and check failure code/path/expected/actual/UTF-8 offset. Handwritten uses dynamic parse and reconstructs offsets after failure. This does not establish equivalence for arbitrary target types, syntax/resource failures or nominal result APIs.

measurement.clock: wall time reported by Google Benchmark; iterations calibrated on CPU time
measurement.summary: median, sample standard deviation and coefficient of variation
measurement.memory_scope: Cumulative successful managed/native/external heap allocations and heap-accounted peak above post-compilation baseline for first call; retained bytes after full GC. RSS is process lifetime high-water including JIT compilation, not decoder-only peak.

comparison_to_previous.reason: Different machine, toolchain, benchmark suite and measurement settings.

benchmark_context.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

baseline_contracts.dynamic_values: Mixed arrays: C++ std::variant<int64_t, string, bool>; Vela dynamic[] with is checks and typed reads.
baseline_contracts.dynamic_dispatch: Bound calls: C++ std::function with a statically typed signature; Vela resolves a public method on a dynamic receiver and checks the int result. C++ has no runtime member-name lookup.
baseline_contracts.json_roundtrip: Construct, encode, decode and validate ordered records containing Unicode and mixed arrays. C++ uses pinned yyjson DOM arenas; Vela uses native Map/dynamic[] graphs, runtime checks and GC. The ratio includes these representation and contract differences, not only generated-code execution.
baseline_contracts.byte_data_little: Zeroed byte buffer, unaligned 64-bit stores/loads and an owner-alias check; C++ vector<byte>/memcpy with explicit little endian.
baseline_contracts.byte_data_big: Zeroed byte buffer, unaligned 64-bit stores/loads and an owner-alias check; C++ vector<byte>/memcpy with explicit big endian.
baseline_contracts.regexp_records: Both compile pinned PCRE2 with UTF/UCP, matching newline/BSR settings, interpreter budgets and no JIT. Build Unicode input, collect nonempty matches, convert coordinates to code points, copy captures and parse numbers inside timing.
baseline_contracts.numeric_parse: Format integers, parse decimal int/double values, verify the fraction and accumulate. C++ uses from_chars and pinned Abseil SimpleAtod; inputs are valid decimal strings.
baseline_contracts.ascii_case: Construct ASCII strings and verify upper/lower round trips. C++ uses ASCII character mapping; this workload makes no Unicode-casing comparison.
baseline_contracts.utc_roundtrip: Construct UTC timestamps, format canonical milliseconds, parse and inspect calendar fields. C++ uses pinned Abseil Time; inputs are valid canonical UTC strings, not the complete Vela error/range contract.

measurement.summary: median, sample standard deviation and coefficient of variation
measurement.memory_scope: Vela heap snapshots; retained bytes include persistent baseline, not process RSS

comparison_to_previous.reason: Previous suite compares typed JSON with handwritten Vela decoding; this suite compares representative Vela JIT workloads with C++.
